newsitem.title: CANADA: CanOxy pays down C$50 mln of debt.
newsitem.headline: CanOxy pays down C$50 mln of debt.

text.p: Canadian Occidental Petroleum Ltd said on Monday it paid down C$50 million of its large debt load with proceeds from the sale of assets.

CanOxy, whose debt jumped to C$2.5 billion with the acquisition earlier this year of Wascana Energy Inc, said the largest asset disposition was the sale of its Mazeppa Gas Plant in southern Alberta to Compton Petroleum Corp.
The company said it was committed to cutting its debt to two times its annualized cash flow within two years while expanding operations.
CanOxy's debt-to-cash flow ratio after the Wascana acquisition was 2.5 times.
